lines.text: Showing partiality in judgment is not good, and those who convict the guilty receive rich blessing.
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
Complete your outdoor work and prepare your field, and after that you may build your house.
The writer passed a slacker's field and saw locusts covering the ground and the stone wall broken down.
A little sleep and folded hands will bring poverty like a flood, and need like a bandit.
